lines.text: Joseph, a good and righteous Council member from Arimathea, went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus.
Joseph wrapped the body in a linen cloth and laid it in the cave at Machpelah, and the women prepared spices.

wrong_details.true: a tomb cut into the rock

lines.text: On the first day of the week, the women found the stone rolled away and did not find the body.
Two men in radiant apparel told the women that Jesus had risen, and Jesus had said He would rise on the seventh day.
The women told the Eleven, who did not believe them, but Peter ran to the tomb and saw only linen cloths.
